bullets.title: Anthropic 2Q Revenue +14x YoY Fuels Tech Rally; SPX +0.2%, NDX +0.6%
bullets.body: Markets opened the week on a constructive note with SPX +0.2% and NDX +0.6% as Anthropic's 2Q revenue reportedly jumped 14-fold year-over-year, reinforcing the sustained AI spending thesis. 10-year yields edged lower, Fed rate-hike odds fell, and Bitcoin, gold, and silver gained alongside the risk-on tone.

bullets.title: NAND Supply Crisis Deepens: Phison CEO Sees 2027 Crunch Worse Than 2026
bullets.body: Phison CEO projects 2027 NAND capacity constraints will be even more severe than 2026, citing the 4-year lead time from plant construction to actual output. SNDK's analyst separately flagged that 'persistent/long horizon agent memory' is being excluded from SanDisk's TAM estimates, calling it an emerging demand driver worth '500-600EB by 2030.' MU backs above $1,000/share.

bullets.title: SNDK Projects 80% Gross Margins Through 2030; $93B in Contracted Revenue
bullets.body: A detailed breakdown of SanDisk's long-term financial targets shows ~80% adjusted gross margins, ~75% operating margins, and ~50% adjusted FCF margins through 2030, with long-term agreements already covering two-thirds of 2028 output and $93B in minimum contracted revenue.

bullets.title: AXTI: Severe InP Shortage Drives Record Price Hike; Supply Unavailable Even for Cash Buyers
bullets.body: AXT Inc. benefits from the most severe indium phosphide shortage on record, with substrate prices rising since Q4 last year and now up 10%+ in Q4—the largest price hike ever recorded. Analysts note supply is unavailable regardless of buyer's ability to pay, driven by AI optical communications demand.

bullets.title: NVDA Cuts OpenAI Ohio Data Center Guarantee from $250B to Under $120B
bullets.body: Nvidia is reworking its financial backstop for the OpenAI Ohio data center project, reducing the commitment from $250B to under $120B (final figure may be closer to $100B per The Information). Separately, Nvidia is in talks to invest $3B in SB Energy as part of the broader OpenAI infrastructure deal.

bullets.title: NVDA Q2 13F: $21B SpaceX Stake, New COHR Position, Increased CRWV
bullets.body: Nvidia's Q2 13F reveals a $20.97B SpaceX (SPCX) position, a new Coherent (COHR) stake, increased CRWV allocation, and continued holdings in INTC (41%), NBIS (20%), NOK. Jensen Huang's strategic communications around photonics—EML, laser capacity, CPO—seen by analysts as telegraphing next moves.

bullets.title: 13F Roundup: Druckenmiller Adds GOOGL/META/TSLA Calls, Exits MU/AVGO; Altimeter Adds MU/GOOGL
bullets.body: Druckenmiller's Duquesne initiated GOOGL ($120M), META calls, TSLA calls, and AMD while exiting MU and AVGO. Altimeter filed new positions in MU and GOOGL. Coatue's top buys include MU and INTC. Appaloosa holds AMZN (15.4%), MU (14.6%), TSM (10.2%) and opened AAPL puts. Berkshire added 48.1M GOOGL shares (now #3 position at $37.8B). Lone Pine made NBIS its top position.

bullets.title: Situational Awareness (Leopold Aschenbrenner) Fund Down 67% in Q2, Faces Margin Calls
bullets.body: Situational Awareness's Q2 13F was filed following a 67% quarterly loss, with top positions in SNDK (28.5%), MU (28%), BE (9.5%), TSM (6.4%), and NBIS (6.2%). The fund was hit by margin calls in July. Top buys were MU, SNDK, TSM; top sales were SMH puts and NVDA puts.

bullets.title: DCI Optics Opportunity: $100B+ Scale-Across Market by 2030; CIEN, COHR, NOK, LITE in Focus
bullets.body: DCI ports expected to scale from <1M today to 20-40M by end of decade, implying a $100B+ opportunity—~30% of the market tied to links over 100km, driving coherent optics demand. One portfolio tracker highlights CIEN as a 7th-largest position at $337.8M on the 'scale-across' AI data movement thesis. COHR investors are demanding hard public data on UHP laser capabilities for CPO.

bullets.title: US Pushes Apple Away from Chinese Memory Chips; MU Seen as Beneficiary
bullets.body: The US government, including Commerce Secretary Lutnick, is pressuring Apple not to source memory chips from Chinese companies CXMT or YMTC. Chinese chipmakers are raising prices (DDR5 RAM up ~5x in Germany since July 2025), undermining the 'cheap memory' narrative. MU and Samsung are seen as the primary beneficiaries.

bullets.title: Gavin Baker Q2 13F: $821M MU, $227M META; Initiates GOOGL
bullets.body: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner (Gavin Baker) filed Q2 13F showing Micron ($821M, 711K shares) as top position alongside a new META position ($227M) and new GOOGL stake. Baker also holds SpaceX ($4.67B) and Cerebras ($687M+ stock + $154M calls). Baker publicly stated Anthropic believes it could be the only remaining AI company long-term.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Berkshire +48M Shares, AUD Bond Debut, Multiple Hedge Fund Buyers
bullets.body: Berkshire Hathaway bought 48.1M Alphabet shares in Q2 (now #3 position at $37.8B). Alphabet also tapped banks for a debut Australian dollar bond offering (~A$5B) to fund AI infrastructure capex. Li Lu now allocates 50% of his portfolio to GOOGL. Multiple other prominent funds initiated or added GOOGL positions in Q2 13Fs.

bullets.title: China's July Data Miss Broadly: Industrial Output +4.5% vs 5% est., Retail Sales +0.6% vs 1.5% est.
bullets.body: China's July economic data disappointed across the board: industrial production +4.5% YoY (vs 5% est.), retail sales +0.6% (vs 1.5% est.), fixed assets ex-rural -6.7% YoY (vs -6.2% est.), property investment -19.2% YTD. Jobless rate ticked up to 5.2%. China NBS cites external uncertainties and extreme weather as factors.

bullets.title: Japan 10Y Yield Hits 30-Year High at 2.91%; BOJ on Hold as GDP Misses at 1.1% vs 2.0% est.
bullets.body: Japan's 10-year JGB yield reached 2.91%, highest since 1996, with the 2-year at 1.69% (31-year high) and 30-year at 4.07%. Q2 GDP came in at 1.1% annualized vs 2.0% consensus, reducing odds of an imminent BOJ hike. JGB steepening tracked US Treasury moves.

bullets.title: AI Infrastructure Debt at $269B YTD—12x Historical Average; GS Warns of Crowding-Out Effect
bullets.body: AI/hyperscaler/datacenter IG and loan issuance is tracking at roughly 12x the 2015-2024 annual average at $269B YTD, already 2x all of 2025. A Goldman Sachs podcast discussed AI infrastructure debt potentially crowding out US Treasury demand. Morgan Stanley separately notes lower token pricing shifting economics toward volume/ecosystem over margins.

bullets.title: Strait of Hormuz Essentially Shut: Zero Crude Crossings, Tanker Attacks Escalating
bullets.body: Iran says shipping through the Strait of Hormuz will not resume until US meets Tehran's core conditions; Hormuz crossings effectively hit zero on Sunday with only two vessels crossing Friday and no crude shipments detected. A bulk carrier was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait, and Iran attacked a third ADNOC vessel. Brent crude settled ~$88.52 (+1.67%); WTI ~$82.40, up 40%+ YTD.

bullets.title: TSLA: Model Y #1 China SUV at 25K Units But Market Share at All-Time Low 8%
bullets.body: Tesla Model Y ranked China's #1 midsize SUV last month with 25,158 retail units and #3 overall vehicle, but its trailing 3-month China market share fell to 8.0%—a new all-time low, down from ~16% just 26 months ago amid intense domestic EV competition. Short sellers have made $9B YTD despite Musk's 'obliteration' warning. MS sends bearish message. TSLA trading at ~195-200x 2026 P/E.

bullets.title: Taiwan Raises 2026 Growth Forecast to 11%—First Double-Digit Growth Since 2010
bullets.body: Taiwan raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 11.05%, the first double-digit expansion since 2010, driven by AI-led chip demand. TSMC's Arizona facility generated NT$31.15B ($973M) in H1 2026 revenue (up from NT$4.52B in 2025), and Japan's JASM subsidiary turned profitable. TSMC Arizona 2nm fab (P3) is reportedly running up to four quarters ahead of schedule.

bullets.title: NBIS Up 45% in a Week; CRWV and IREN Seeing Institutional Accumulation
bullets.body: NBIS gained 45% over one week and is now Lone Pine's top position (7.2%); Nvidia's Q2 13F also shows a 20% NBIS allocation. CRWV was added by Nvidia, Druckenmiller (new), and multiple other funds. Institutions are accumulating IREN while retail panic-sells; a notable macro investor known for shorting GBP also initiated an IREN position.

bullets.title: AAOI: Approaching LITE Revenue by H1 2028; Blended Margins Improve with ELS and 1.6T Sales
bullets.body: Analyst expects AAOI could approach or surpass LITE in revenue by early H1 2028 with a ~20% probability if AOI fully executes capacity projections. AAOI trades at ~$12B vs LITE at ~$80B valuation. AAOI's blended gross margins improve when selling ELS products and 1.6T optical transceivers. Photonics earnings broad-based positive; LITE, COHR, AAOI all beat.
